Title: PPC (Google Ads) consultant - Russian speaking
I have an existing website (on Wix) and existing Google Ads campaign. It brings some leads, but clearly it needs optimization. I'm looking for someone who can consult me on an hourly basis (2 sessions per week, 1 hour each), and walk me through setting the campaign, optimizing it, activating Google Analytics, Tag Manager, etc. During these sessions, I'll be sharing my screen and you'll be walking me through what needs to be done. I can pay hourly + bonus once we reach certain KPIs. The website and search campaign are in Russian language, so I'm looking for someone whose first language is Russian. text:
Your Google Ads campaign is already generating leads, but it needs hands-on optimization, proper tracking, and clearer measurement so you can improve performance and scale what works.

My name is Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable working in Google Sheets, Excel, SQL, Power BI, and I also have direct experience with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, which is especially important for the kind of setup and troubleshooting you’re looking for.

I’d be a good fit for your hourly consulting format because I work well in screen-share sessions where we can go step by step through the campaign, identify what needs fixing, and implement changes together. I can help you review the current Google Ads structure, improve tracking, activate Google Analytics and Tag Manager correctly, and make sure the data you’re seeing is reliable enough to guide decisions.

Two relevant projects I’ve worked on:

- **GA4 migration and tracking plan for Verdant Skincare**: I built a tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off. The work included mapping **46 events** and ensuring **no gap in year-on-year reporting**.
- **Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare**: I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to **18% of ad budget reallocated** and **customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter**.

That background makes me comfortable with the measurement side of paid search, even when the immediate task is consultative rather than hands-on execution. I can help you understand what to change, why it matters, and how to verify whether the changes are improving performance.

I’m happy to work in your 2 sessions per week / 1 hour each format and focus on practical, clear next steps each time. If this sounds like a fit, I’d be glad to discuss your current setup and how we can start improving it.
